# DPL Documentation Writing Skill (Obsolete)

This skill is **obsolete** and defines no rules. Do not read it for guidance and do not invoke it, automatically or manually.

Everything it used to cover has moved:

| Former topic | Current location |
|---|---|
| YAML frontmatter fields by article type | `.github/skills/dpl-docs-article-from-links/SKILL.md` → DPL Article Conventions, Section 1 |
| Slug conventions | `.github/skills/dpl-docs-article-from-links/SKILL.md` → Section 2 |
| Feature, FormatProvider, and Knowledge Base templates | `.github/skills/dpl-docs-article-from-links/SKILL.md` → Section 3 |
| Heading and example-heading conventions | `.github/skills/dpl-docs-article-from-links/SKILL.md` → Section 4; `.github/skills/telerik-documentation-style-guide/style-structure/SKILL.md` |
| Code examples, code comments, snippet placeholders | `.github/skills/dpl-docs-article-from-links/SKILL.md` → Section 5 |
| Admonition syntax | `.github/skills/dpl-docs-article-from-links/SKILL.md` → Section 6 |
| Cross-linking and See Also | `.github/skills/dpl-docs-article-from-links/SKILL.md` → Section 7; `.github/skills/telerik-documentation-style-guide/style-metadata-links/SKILL.md` |
| Images and version badges | `.github/skills/dpl-docs-article-from-links/SKILL.md` → Sections 8 and 9 |
| Product terminology and content to omit | `.github/skills/dpl-docs-article-from-links/SKILL.md` → Sections 10 and 11 |
| Text formatting, tables | `.github/skills/telerik-documentation-style-guide/style-formatting/SKILL.md` |
| Tone, voice, grammar, punctuation, lists | `.github/skills/telerik-documentation-style-guide/style-writing-tone/`, `style-grammar-words/`, `style-structure/` |

Use `.github/skills/dpl-docs-article-from-links/SKILL.md` as the single source for DPL article conventions. Where it overlaps with `.github/skills/telerik-documentation-style-guide/`, the conventions in `dpl-docs-article-from-links` take priority.
